sql.processStepRequirement.getRequirementsFo: select psr.*, ot.operator_type, psrt.process_step_requirement_type, ps.id as parent_id, ps.process_step_name as parent_name, cf.field_name, cfn.company_function_name, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(params))) FROM ( select rpdv.id, rpdv.archived, dfp.db_function_id as "dbFunctionId", dfp.parameter_name as "parameterName", rpdv.db_function_param_id as "dbFunctionParamId", rpdv.process_step_requirement_id as "processStepRequirementId", rpdv.default_value as "defaultValue" from flow.db_function_param dfp left join flow.requirement_param_default_value rpdv on rpdv.db_function_param_id = dfp.id and rpdv.process_step_requirement_id = psr.id where dfp.db_function_id = cfn.db_function_id and dfp.parameter_type_id = 2 and rpdv.archived is not true ) params), '[]') AS "requirementParamDefaultValues" from flow.process_step_requirement psr left join flow.custom_field_group cfg on cfg.id = psr.custom_field_group_id left join flow.custom_field cf on cf.id = cfg.custom_field_id left join flow.custom_field_group_type cfgt on cfgt.id = cfg.custom_field_group_type_id left join flow.process_step ps on ps.id = cfgt.process_step_id left join flow.company_function cfn on cfn.id = psr.company_function_id inner join flow.operator_type ot on ot.id = psr.operator_type_id inner join flow.process_step_requirement_type psrt on psrt.id = psr.process_step_requirement_type_id where psr.archived is not true and psr.process_step_id = :processStepId order by psr.requirement_nbr
sql.processStepRequirement.getRequirement: select psr.*, ot.operator_type, psrt.process_step_requirement_type, ps.id as parent_id, ps.process_step_name as parent_name, cf.field_name, cfn.company_function_name, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(params))) FROM ( select rpdv.id, rpdv.archived, dfp.db_function_id as "dbFunctionId", dfp.parameter_name as "parameterName", rpdv.db_function_param_id as "dbFunctionParamId", rpdv.process_step_requirement_id as "processStepRequirementId", rpdv.default_value as "defaultValue" from flow.db_function_param dfp left join flow.requirement_param_default_value rpdv on rpdv.db_function_param_id = dfp.id and rpdv.process_step_requirement_id = psr.id where dfp.db_function_id = cfn.db_function_id and dfp.parameter_type_id = 2 and rpdv.archived is not true ) params), '[]') AS "requirementParamDefaultValues" from flow.process_step_requirement psr left join flow.custom_field_group cfg on cfg.id = psr.custom_field_group_id left join flow.custom_field cf on cf.id = cfg.custom_field_id left join flow.custom_field_group_type cfgt on cfgt.id = cfg.custom_field_group_type_id left join flow.process_step ps on ps.id = cfgt.process_step_id left join flow.company_function cfn on cfn.id = psr.company_function_id inner join flow.operator_type ot on ot.id = psr.operator_type_id inner join flow.process_step_requirement_type psrt on psrt.id = psr.process_step_requirement_type_id where psr.id = :id
sql.processStepRequirement.deleteRequirement: update flow.process_step_requirement set modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now(), archived = true where id = :requirementId
sql.processStepRequirement.getRequirementTyp: select * from flow.process_step_requirement_type where archived is not true
sql.processStepRequirement.updateRequirement: update flow.process_step_requirement set operator_type_id = :operatorTypeId, requirement_value = :requirementValue, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.processStepRequirement.insertRequirement: insert into flow.process_step_requirement(process_step_requirement_type_id, operator_type_id, requirement_value, custom_field_group_id, company_function_id, requirement_nbr, date_created, created_by_id, process_step_id) values (:requirementTypeId, :operatorTypeId, :requirementValue, :customFieldGroupId, :companyFunctionId, (select coalesce(max(requirement_nbr),0) + 1 from flow.process_step_requirement where process_step_id = :processStepId), now(), :createdById, :processStepId)

insert into flow.requirement_param_default_value (db_function_param_id, process_step_requirement_id, default_value, created_by_id, date_created) values (:dbFunctionParamId, :processStepRequirementId, :defaultValue, :createdById, now());
sql.processStepRequirement.updateRequirement: update flow.requirement_param_default_value set default_value = :defaultValue, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
